minutes.headline: Select Board ratified Lt. Gamel as interim police chief and reviewed FY20 goals and draft FY21 goals; votes set for Aug 4.
minutes.summary: The board ratified the town manager's appointment of the lieutenant as interim police chief effective August 1, after legislators and members honored the retiring chief. They reviewed the pending charter changes awaiting House action and went through FY20 goals for the town manager and board. Draft FY21 goals were discussed, with a vote deferred to August 4. Public comment covered stormwater and conservation filing, the cemetery and DPW, and the cost of a handicap ramp.

what_happened.line: The Select Board ratified the town manager's appointment of the police lieutenant as interim chief, by roll call with one member abstaining.
The board and town manager went through FY20 goals, with the old primary school and its demolition estimate discussed.
Draft FY21 board goals were set out: old primary school work, a reappointment policy, and encouraging more volunteers for vacancies.
Meeting location and ADA access, board liaisons and a tricentennial committee were put on future agendas rather than made goals.
Goals are to be typed up and voted on August 4, and approval of minutes was deferred to the same date.

why_it_matters: The interim police chief change affects who leads the town's police department while the appointment stands, and the FY21 goals set what the board and manager will work on, including the old primary school site.
A resident questioned the town hall handicap ramp's cost, which is paid partly by a grant and partly from the facilities budget, which is mostly taxes.
watch_next: August 4: the board is to vote on the typed-up FY21 goals and take up the deferred minutes.
The draft appointment policy the town manager is to send to the board.
